In this episode, Dr. Alyssa B discusses the importance of engaging with natural light, understanding the interconnectedness of our visual perception, and unlocking the profound potential within our minds and bodies. With insights into improving conditions like ADHD, autism, and brain injuries, the conversation highlights the revolutionary concept of enlivening consciousness for overall health.

Tune in to explore how to safeguard your vision, embrace holistic eye health, and deepen your connection with the universe. Dr. Alyssa B shares transformative tips that go beyond conventional eye care, offering listeners a chance to see the world through a new lens—one of wellness, balance, and infinite possibilities.
